_about: Hand-written gold standard for docx formula text. Each item: the source formula as a person reads it, and the LaTeX it must mean. Each entry of 'gold' is one acceptable reading; an entry is a list of formula segments in that paragraph. Written by reading the source, not by copying converter output. No MS Word was available: the samples follow Word's OMML shapes by hand.

F3-复核样本.docx.label: argmax
